description: Land Acquisition - Alupotha, Badalkumbura D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire specific land parcels in the Badalkumbura Divisional Secretariat area. It contains detailed descriptions of the land to be acquired (including lot numbers, names, claimants, and extent), which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it involves government action, the primary focus is on land acquisition rather than government structure or personnel changes.
